    hs={r for r in range(h) if len({inp[r][c] for c in range(w)})==1 and inp[r][0]!=bg}
    rest=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if inp[r][c]!=bg and c not in vs and r not in hs]

    pat=[[inp[r][c] for c in range(minc,maxc+1)] for r in range(minr,maxr+1)]
    ph=maxr-minr+1; pw=maxc-minc+1

            row.append(pat[tr][tc])
        out.append(row)
    return out
